title: amazing way to buy a mattress
text: amazing way to buy a mattress. I needed to purchase a mattress and didn't want the hassel of borrowing a truck, shopping for it, lugging it home up 2 flights of stairs.  Somehow these guys can compress the mattress into a shippable (is that a word?) size, move it half way across the country with ease, get it to the right address within the time allotted.  Amazing.  The compressed size also meant it was easier to get up the stairs too!.  Would so buy another mattress this way when the time comes.  And the super saver shipping was the sweetest icing on the cake.
